blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code
SpeedBlip's landing page (Chunk 2b) has six sections, each with a clear job:

items: Hero - Above the fold. Headline, subheadline, and two CTAs: "Run a Speed Test" (primary) and "View Demo" (secondary). Dashboard screenshot below the fold.
How It Works - Three-step visual: Run a test, see your speed, get notified. No more than one line of text per step.
Features - Six feature cards in a 2x3 grid. Each card has an icon, a short title, and one sentence. Icons from Lucide React.
FAQ - Four questions with accordion expand/collapse. Addresses the top concerns: "Is my data private?", "Do I need to install anything?", "How accurate is it?", "Does it run in the background?"
CTA Banner - Full-width section with the primary CTA again. Reminder that it is free and no account is needed.
Footer - Logo, tagline, and three links: GitHub, Privacy, Contact.

blocks.content: Every section was described in this level of detail in the Chunk 2b prompt. When Claude Code received that spec, it built the entire landing page in one run with no ambiguity about what went where.
